title: Puthoff floats a joint space program

tellings.quote: I was like is it is it their program you know is it the NHI program or is it our program and he goes what if it's a joint space program

plain: An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says he asked a physicist, Hal Puthoff, whether a hidden space effort belonged to "them," a non-human intelligence, or to us. He says Puthoff answered by asking, "what if it's a joint space program?" If true, it would mean humans and non-humans are working on space together in secret.
